## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 411 captures during June 2023. The activity was recorded as part of routine clinic operations, with the site continuing to provide image capture for subsequent review and grading. No changes to the service arrangement were reported during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 411 captures, 84 were ungradable. This resulted in an ungradable rate of 20.4. The result indicates that a substantial proportion of images could not be used for assessment and should remain an operational focus for the site. Staff raised no new equipment faults during June 2023.

## Grading

Grading identified 89 referable results from the activity completed at Market Eye Clinic. These results were available for the appropriate follow-up pathway. The median lag from capture to grading was 2, indicating that grading was generally completed without an extended delay. Continued monitoring of image quality and grading timeliness will support service oversight and help identify whether further operational action is required.
